alice_ai_art_2_evaluation.png.description: Author-selected Alice AI ART 2.0 image-editing evaluation figure from the Yandex article. Original downloaded PNG retained byte-for-byte, including Russian labels. Shows relevance, preservation, and defects with good/bad examples.

energy-landscape.svg.description: Original analytic plot, not copied from the cited tutorial. One-dimensional energy E(x)=-log p(x)+const, shifted to have minimum zero, for an equally weighted Gaussian mixture with means +/-1.5 and sigma=0.7. This density is also the first-coordinate marginal of the Langevin demo. Arrows point downhill. Generated by tools/render-energy-landscape.py; citation supplies EBM background.
